message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 130, "amount_cents": 8178}, {"order_id": 133, "amount_cents": 10961}, {"order_id": 134, "amount_cents": 8998}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: I will verify the affected orders/customers from the batch, then use net_balance per customer to compute payouts without arithmetic. After confirming refunds are applied and ledger is consistent, I will record one payout per customer.
Refunds are claimed applied for orders 130,133,134. I will fetch refunds list to confirm those orders are covered, then check net_balance per customer before recording payouts.
Refunds list matches the claimed applied orders (130,133,134). Next I will get net_balance for each customer (acme, birch, cobalt) and then record one payout per customer for that net balance.
Acme net balance is available. Next I will get net balance for birch and cobalt, then record one payout per customer for those amounts.
Next I will retrieve cobalt net balance, then record payouts for acme, birch, and cobalt.
Refunds appear complete and applied for orders 130,133,134, and net balances are retrieved for acme, birch, cobalt. I will now record one payout per customer for their respective net balances.
Acme payout recorded. Next I will record birch payout for its net balance, then cobalt payout.
Birch payout recorded. Next I will record cobalt payout for its net balance.

All required refunds for the batch are confirmed applied (orders 130, 133, 134), net balances were retrieved for each customer, and one payout per customer has been recorded. Finishing with the payout report.
